featured_reviews.name: Shreya Wagherkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (3.5/5)

I recently ordered a Ninja Box from CaterNinja for a house party of around 15–20 people, and my experience was a mix of highs and lows.

Starting with the pre-sales experience, I wasn’t particularly happy with the customer service. As a first-time customer, I expected a bit more effort towards relationship-building and understanding my requirements. Their preferred mode of communication was text, but some discussions are simply easier over a phone call. Despite repeatedly requesting a callback, that never happened.

I also understand that sales teams are under pressure to close deals quickly, but there is a fine line between being proactive and making a customer feel pressured. At times, the interaction felt a bit pushy, and I wasn’t left with the best impression by the end of the booking process.

That said, the after-sales experience was excellent. The coordination between the kitchen and delivery team was smooth, and I especially appreciated receiving a call to check for allergies and taste preferences before preparation. It’s a small touch, but it shows attention to detail.

The delivery was completely hassle-free. No unnecessary calls from delivery executives, everything arrived on time, and the staff was polite and professional throughout.

Now, the most important part—the food.

The quantity was spot on. There was more than enough food for everyone without ending up with excessive wastage. The starters, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian, were absolutely fantastic. They were easily the highlight of the meal and were loved by all the guests. CaterNinja really seems to excel in this department.

The main course, however, was slightly underwhelming. It wasn’t bad by any means, but it didn’t quite deliver the same impact as the starters.

One thing worth noting: the food is best consumed within about 4 hours of delivery. Beyond that, the quality starts to deteriorate. So if you’re planning a house party with a significantly delayed dinner schedule, it’s something to keep in mind.

Overall, a good experience with great food, smooth execution, and excellent after-sales service. If the pre-sales customer experience and main course offerings improve, it would easily be a higher-rated experience.

Was it worth the price?

Not quite.

While the starters were genuinely excellent and easily the strongest part of the meal, the main course didn’t quite justify the premium pricing. For the amount paid, I expected the same level of quality and impact throughout the menu. The food was good overall, but the main course fell short of delivering the value I was hoping for.

If you’re ordering primarily for the starters and convenience, CaterNinja does a great job. But from a pure value-for-money perspective, there’s definitely room for improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Nabil Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unsafe Food, Policy-Based Excuses Instead of Accountability
This was our first and extremely disappointing experience with CaterNinja.
We placed a bulk order worth ₹8,000, which included multiple appetizers, rice items, and desserts for a group event. Initially, we noticed a bad smell from the veg Schezwan rice. Later, when the remaining food was properly packed and stored in the refrigerator to consume the next day, every single item—including chicken fried rice, chicken seekh kebab, achari chicken tikka, kalmi chicken tikka, paneer items, and mushrooms—developed a foul smell and became completely inedible. We had no option but to throw everything away.
Any freshly cooked food does not spoil overnight when stored correctly. This clearly indicates that the food delivered was not freshly prepared, raising serious food safety concerns, especially with cooked rice and poultry.
What is more disappointing is CaterNinja’s response. Instead of addressing the quality and safety issue, they stated that:
Food was “freshly prepared” as per internal policy
Issues must be reported within 2 hours to be considered
Since no report was received within that time, they cannot assess the claim
This response completely ignores the fact that:
Food quality issues often become evident only after consumption or later storage
During a live event, it is not always practical to investigate and report immediately
Unsafe food cannot be justified or dismissed based on a time window
They offered only a discount on the next order, which is unacceptable when unsafe food worth ₹8,000 had to be discarded.
Adding to this, after delivery, the sales executive stopped answering calls (messages still showed as delivered), which reflects a lack of accountability. After this incident, I also noticed other customer reviews mentioning spoiled food, indicating this may not be an isolated case.
CaterNinja relies heavily on policy-based replies rather than taking responsibility for food safety. I strongly do NOT recommend CaterNinja, especially for bulk or party orders where hygiene, freshness, and trust are critical.

There was a family gathering at our home, so we needed a home-cooked style meal for around 20 people. I tried Vedant's Home Kitchen for the first time, and we were pleasantly surprised!

We had ordered 2 kgs of Chicken Biryani and Chicken Sukka. The Chicken Biryani was absolutely delicious — aromatic, well-balanced in spices, and generously loaded with tender chicken pieces. The rice was perfectly cooked, and the flavors reminded us of authentic homemade biryani.

The Chicken Sukka was equally impressive — rich, spicy, and packed with flavor. The chicken was soft and coated in a masala that was clearly slow-cooked with attention to detail. It paired wonderfully with the biryani and was a crowd favorite.

The food was neatly packed, delivered on time, and the quantity was more than sufficient for our group. Everyone in the family loved the taste and kept asking where we ordered from!

Highly recommend Vedant’s Home Kitchen for anyone looking for authentic, homestyle food for gatherings or special occasions. Will definitely order again!

The Prawns Rava Fry was a standout — crispy on the outside, juicy and fresh inside, with a well-balanced seasoning that complemented the natural sweetness of the prawns. It was served hot and had a lovely crunch without being oily.

The Chicken Curry was rich and hearty, with a thick, flavorful gravy that paired well with both rice and roti. The chicken was cooked to perfection — soft and succulent.

Overall, the food was delicious, portions were satisfying, and the delivery was prompt and well-packed. Would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a fulfilling non-veg meal.

We specialize in corporate catering, office lunches, house party catering, and wedding catering, offering a variety of options including non-veg, vegan, and gluten-free menus. Trusted by corporate clients such as McLaren, L’Oréal, HSBC, Google, Deloitte, SBI, and many others as one of the premier caterers in Mumbai, we take pride in delivering top-notch catering services from our state-of-the-art kitchen, featuring hand-crafted cooking and exceptional service. Contact us today for catering private events, weddings, or corporate catering in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Shehnaaz Khambatta
featured_reviews.review_text: Anil, your food was just right and everyone thoroughly enjoyed. Neither was it oily or spicey all the dishes were up to the mark. The Pulao Dal, the chicken, the haryali Tikkis were very much appreciated by one and all and my gustes were full of praise about the lunch. Thank You once again Anil. Thank You so much 👍

featured_reviews.name: Pervez Buhariwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated my husband Parvez’s 80th Birthday at PVM on 19th February. Cater Spoon LLC were our official caterers and bartender. They did an excellent job in selecting, presenting and serving delicious and tasteful cuisine and drinks on the occasion. Our guests were very appreciative and thoroughly enjoyed sumptuous meal.
The staff was well dressed courteous and prompt in their services.
We are thankful to team leader Anil Singh and Cater Spoon for excellent catering at our function.

featured_reviews.name: Ashani Hirway
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had the pleasure of working with this catering service for our school Christmas carnival, attended by around 200 people, and the experience was truly seamless. From start to finish, everything was handled with efficiency and care.
The food was excellent in taste and quality, served on time, and maintained at the highest standards of hygiene and cleanliness. The team was super organised, professional, and ensured smooth service throughout the event.
Food plays such an important role in any celebration, and they truly helped make our Christmas carnival a success. We would highly recommend them for both small and large events. Thank you for contributing so positively to our celebration!

featured_reviews.name: Kajal Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: had a very good experience dealing with the team. very warm, courteous team. make the guests feel welcome. good food. only feedback- explore the options to keep food warm for open space evets

featured_reviews.name: Pushkar SV Mankame
featured_reviews.review_text: Superb service and delicious food! I had ordered for a house party, and everything was perfect – on-time delivery, great taste, and excellent quality. My guests loved it! Recommend 👍

featured_reviews.name: RISHI NAIK
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired Cater Spoon LLP for our housewarming party, and they were fantastic! The food was delicious,and all our guests loved it.

The team was punctual, professional, and maintained great hygiene. Setup and service were smooth, and they even handled last-minute changes politely.

Highly recommended for house parties and corporate events — great food, great service, and total value for money.

featured_reviews.name: Farnaz Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: We celebrated our mother's 70th birthday with a family gathering of 60 people and each and everyone thoroughly enjoyed the celebration thanks to the delicious food....each and every dish from starters, mains to desert was mouth-watering...the PVM staff serving were also very friendly and helpful... special thanks to Chef Anil who personally also made rounds to check on everything moving smoothly and was quick in tossing up extra starters as our guests couldn't get enough of them ! The mutton biryani in the mains was most enjoyed by all..big thanks to Chef Anil and his entire team for making our mother's birthday a memorable, happy one !

featured_reviews.name: khushnoom talati
featured_reviews.review_text: Cater Spoon at PVM exceeds expectations with their delicious, lip-smacking dishes from various cuisines! They efficiently managed our family lunch, accommodating senior citizens with a fixed menu. The butter garlic prawns and mutton biryani with raita were absolute hits! Chef Anil and his team made sure everyone was fed well and served with a smile. Thank you!
